    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="es">
    <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
    <title>CHURREARG™ · Calendario Drop 01 · 15 Mayo–10 Junio 2026</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@700;900&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
    :root{--g:#C9A84C;--g2:#E8C97A;--bg:#090909;--c:#131313;--b:#1E1E1E;--tx:#BFBFBF;--w:#EFEFEF}
    *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
    body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}
    header{background:#0C0C0C;border-bottom:1px solid var(--g);padding:24px 20px 18px;text-align:center;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200}
    h1{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:clamp(17px,3vw,30px);color:var(--g);letter-spacing:.2em}
    header p{font-size:10px;color:#555;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:4px}
    .stats{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:24px;margin-top:12px}
    .stat span{display:block;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:19px;color:var(--g);text-align:center}
    .stat small{font-size:9px;color:#444;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
    .sch{max-width:420px;margin:12px auto 0}
    .sch input{width:100%;background:#161616;border:1px solid var(--b);color:var(--w);padding:8px 13px;border-radius:3px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:12px;outline:none}
    .sch input:focus{border-color:var(--g)}
    .wrap{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 14px 60px}
    .lgd{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;padding:18px;font-size:10px;color:#444;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
    .lgd span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
    .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid}
    .dot.g{border-color:var(--g);background:rgba(201,168,76,.2)}
    .dot.p{border-color:#5A4A9A;background:rgba(90,74,154,.2)}
    .dot.r{border-color:#9A4A4A;background:rgba(154,74,74,.2)}
    .dot.d{border-color:var(--b)}
    .ds{margin-bottom:40px;border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
    .ds.ld{border-color:var(--g);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(201,168,76,.1)}
    .ds.rd{border-color:#5A4A9A}
    .ds.cd{border-color:#9A4A4A}
    .dh{background:#111;padding:14px 18px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--b)}
    .dt{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--g);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;flex:1}
    .dbg{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:2px}
    .dbg.lg{background:rgba(201,168,76,.15);color:var(--g);border:1px solid var(--g)}
    .dbg.rg{background:rgba(90,74,154,.15);color:#9A8AE0;border:1px solid #5A4A9A}
    .dbg.cg{background:rgba(154,74,74,.15);color:#E08A8A;border:1px solid #9A4A4A}
    .rb{width:100%;background:rgba(90,74,154,.08);border:1px solid #5A4A9A;border-radius:3px;padding:9px 13px;font-size:11px;color:#9A8AE0}
    .sl{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#333;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 18px 7px;background:#0E0E0E;border-bottom:1px solid #181818}
    .stl{color:#2A2A5A;border-top:1px solid #181818}
    .cr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(290px,1fr));gap:1px;background:#181818}
    .sr{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr))}
    .card{background:var(--c);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
    .card:hover{background:#161616}
    .ci{position:relative;height:190px;background:#0D0D0D;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0}
    .story-card .ci{height:165px}
    .ci img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
    .ni{height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#222;font-size:11px}
    .fn{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);color:var(--g);font-size:9px;padding:4px 7px;letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:600}
    .bge{position:absolute;top:7px;right:7px;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:2px}
    .pb{background:rgba(201,168,76,.18);color:var(--g);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.35)}
    .sb{background:rgba(90,74,154,.18);color:#9A8AE0;border:1px solid rgba(90,74,154,.35)}
    .cb{padding:13px 15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;flex:1}
    .hr{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:var(--g);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}
    .ds-text,.ds{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--w);flex:1}
    .tg{font-size:11px;color:#505050;line-height:1.5}
    .sel{user-select:all;cursor:text}
    .bc{background:transparent;border:1px solid #252525;color:#555;padding:4px 11px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;border-radius:2px;transition:all .2s;align-self:flex-start}
    .bc:hover{border-color:var(--g);color:var(--g)}
    .bc.ok{border-color:#4CAF50;color:#4CAF50}
    .bt{margin-top:-1px}
    .bd{display:inline-block;background:var(--g);color:#000;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 13px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:2px;align-self:flex-start;transition:background .2s;margin-top:3px}
    .bd:hover{background:var(--g2)}
    .ds .ds,.ds .tg{font-size:13px}
    div.ds{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--w)}
    .cb .ds{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--w);flex:1}
    @media(max-width:580px){.cr{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stats{gap:14px}}
    </style>
    </head>
    <body>
    <header>
    <h1>CHURREARG™</h1>
    <p>Calendario Drop 01 · 15 Mayo – 10 Junio 2026</p>
